in_marathi.name: Basavaraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Bases (Basi meaning foundation and Raja meaning king)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basavaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Basavaraj is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Basa' meaning foundation and 'Raja' meaning king. This name is attributed to Lord Basaveshwara, who is believed to be the embodiment of Lord Shiva and is the presiding deity of the Lingayat faith. Basavaraj is a powerful name that signifies strength, stability, and leadership. It is believed that individuals named Basavaraj are blessed with strong foundations and the ability to rule their lives with courage and wisdom.
